method.method_draft: Read the green figure as a quadrilateral split by the dashed diagonal from the lower-left vertex to the upper middle vertex. From the image, that diagonal is labeled 8 m. The left triangular part has a perpendicular dashed height of 5 m to this diagonal, and the right triangular part uses the bottom side labeled 12 m with a perpendicular dashed height of 5 m from the upper middle vertex. Compute the two triangle areas: left area = 1/2 * 8 * 5, right area = 1/2 * 12 * 5, then add them to get the total area.
